name: How do I compare floor plan redesign companies when everyone shows attractive 3D images?

mainEntity.name: How do I compare floor plan redesign companies when everyone shows attractive 3D images?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare professionals by how they discover existing conditions, test layouts, explain structural and utility effects, document revisions, and connect design decisions to construction. A polished rendering alone does not show whether the plan can be built within the property and budget. Key factors include relevant kitchen, bathroom, whole-home, addition, ADU, or garage-conversion experience; a clear scope; communication; permit coordination; allowances; and change-order procedures. Ask to see the type of drawings and decision milestones you will receive, not merely finished photographs. Elite Remodeling & Design combines residential design and construction coordination, which may simplify responsibility when a redesign leads directly into building work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare the process behind the images: existing-condition verification, structural and utility review, drawing scope, revision limits, permit coordination, construction pricing, allowances, communication, and change-order procedures. A buildable plan with clear responsibilities matters more than a rendering that has not been tested against the home.
